headline: Gold and silver rebound 2–3% after last week's crash
summary: Spot gold rose about 2% and silver about 3% on Monday as the dollar and crude eased, after last week's steepest weekly fall in eight months; a December Fed rate rise is still about 97% priced and US PCE inflation data is due this week.

headline: Happiest Minds hits 52-week low after eight straight falls
summary: The stock touched ₹291.15, down about 8% over eight sessions and about 41% over a year; the report notes higher debt and interest costs in the half-year and promoter pledging of about 25%.

headline: Promoter's entire 64.26% Kronox stake now pledged
summary: Indo Borax disclosed a further pledge of 50.26% of Kronox's shares (created 17 November), so all of its 64.26% holding now secures the roughly ₹225 crore loan used to buy the stake. The ₹157.27 open offer closed today.

headline: Gold heads for biggest weekly fall since March; silver at lowest since Sep 2025
summary: MCX gold has fallen about 9% in three sessions and silver about 13%, as Fed officials signal further rate rises, US 10-year yields stay above 5% and the dollar strengthens.
